ModMetaData.name: RimDroid Readability 0.2.4
ModMetaData.author: Erenalp
ModMetaData.description: Large map indicators, item grouping and a target finder for the verified RimWorld 1.6 reference on RimDroid Native. Follows the selected game language with 29 included translations. Disabled by default. Full device and performance acceptance remains pending. Uses the Harmony already loaded by RimDroid.
